line: - **sprint-or-modes** The PO picks: a full design is usually a design sprint; the five modes are the base of everything, used piecemeal elsewhere.
note: The tail 'a chat's research can count as Empathize material' is in research-as-empathize (drafted under ideo-log#2, which carries the same sentence); 'then still run that stage' (do not skip Empathize) is in open-a-design. PO 2026-11-23（经 Supporter，Master 转来；原话在 review/po-review-2026-11-23.md）：sprint-or-modes 按 PO 的意思重写——由 PO 说用哪种；完整的设计一般走设计冲刺；五模式是一切的基础，零散着用。删掉「只有原型必须拿角色卡测才默认设计冲刺」（清单行、flow-maps 的虚线）。

line: - **research-as-empathize** Chat or IDEO-log research can count as Empathize material, but a design sprint still starts on the PO's permission.
where_else: What the five modes and the design sprint's stages are (stages stand on modes, the book's steps, a PO decision between stages, role-card tests) is in plugins/ideo-scrum/skills/design-kernel/SKILL.md and plugins/ideo-scrum/skills/ideo-kernel/SKILL.md.
note: The annotation asked to keep 'IDEO log counts as Empathize material' and 'no map, Lightning Demos, storyboard'; both are kept. The old 'Do not mix them' lost its referent once the line stands alone, so the line now says what is kept apart. PO 2026-11-23（经 Supporter，Master 转来；原话在 review/po-review-2026-11-23.md）：整条 modes-are-not-the-sprint 删（PO：「谁说的 ideo 不做闪电演示啊，不做故事板啊……这个不对」）。还对的两点：①「IDEO 五阶段法」指五模式本身→details/names.md；②在设计里用的方法，产出写进那个阶段的设计日志章节→ideo-in-every-stage。

line: - **open-ideo-log** Outside a design: 1-2 methods in one session go in the log served; more opens an IDEO log. Read details/ideo-ending.md first.
note: The threshold (one or two methods, or one session) is the author's; the PO may set it again. PO 2026-11-23（经 Supporter，Master 转来；原话在 review/po-review-2026-11-23.md）（IDEO 日志这一节去重）：open-ideo-log 合进原 ideo-log-home（文件夹）与 read-mode-file（章里放什么、先读模式与方法的文件）；清单行只留「在设计之外」的触发，细则放 details/ideo-ending.md；先读模式与方法文件的规矩 ideo-kernel 的 Use Protocol 里有。

line: - **ideo-log-ends** Conclusions flow back to the log that asked and the PO decides; archive at the next Review. Read details/ideo-ending.md first.
where_else: The Now and Waiting for PO header format is in plugins/ideo-scrum/template/ideo-backlog-template.md (lines 4-5); the archiving of an IDEO log is also in sprint-log#17 (the Review rule).
note: Long file keeps the prototype handoff word for word: a prototype whose conclusions will be built goes to the Sprint that builds them, as that Sprint's specification; if that Sprint is not open yet it stays in the IDEO folder until the handoff; any other standalone IDEO prototype is deleted when the work is done. ideo-kernel's SKILL.md points back to this rule. PO 2026-11-23（经 Supporter，Master 转来；原话在 review/po-review-2026-11-23.md）（ideo-log-home 与上面某条重复）：ideo-log-home 并入 open-ideo-log；文件夹、For 格、无承诺都在 details/ideo-ending.md「Where it lives」，文件夹清单在 details/folders.md。
